sourceFile: 20. BRS-161014 Report test DOE Laser cutting main 2_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft uses citeable DOE rows but misgroups changed factors and includes invalid extracted measurements.
issues: Laser parameter DOE and jig improvement are merged into one changed factor.
Baseline combines Normal and Normal Jig incorrectly.
Change domain is inaccurate for laser cutting process settings.
Outcome metrics and measurement stats include header-derived artifacts.
Evidence is overbroad and omits clear section-level grouping logic.
correctionPlan: Split changed factors into laser cutting parameter DOE and jig improvement, or justify one context with subgroups.
Define baseline and test conditions per DOE round using date/round/type/setting keys.
Use process/laser settings as the change domain and NG/FS damage/NG rate as outcomes.
Remove bogus measurement/spec summaries parsed from headers.
Cite header rows plus exact data rows for each comparison and include decision rows if present.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are too broad and not sufficient for final evidence.
